scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:portable: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/router-ia run build
scripts.build:cloudflare: PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/router-ia run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/router-ia run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
